description: Drive-Workspace-rule compliance: a generated/improved Claude Desktop/Web deep-research prompt must REFERENCE Drive doc(s) by NAME and NEVER instruct Etan to attach/upload/drag files (the prompt body AND the dispatch message). Mechanically scored by _shared/research/drive-grounding-gate.sh.

cases.name: produce-prompt-no-attach
cases.prompt: Write me a Claude deep-research prompt comparing event sourcing vs CQRS for our real-time collab app. Ground it in my 'Collab Architecture' design doc, which is in my Google Drive.
cases.expected_behavior: Emits a self-contained deep-research prompt with a ## Grounding block that REFERENCES 'Collab Architecture' by NAME (Claude's connected Drive workspace pulls it). The prompt and any hand-off message do NOT tell Etan to attach, upload, or drag a file/folder.
assertions: Prompt includes a Grounding block that references the doc by name
Prompt contains NO instruction to attach a file or folder
Prompt contains NO instruction to upload a file
Dispatch/hand-off message does NOT say 'attach the Drive folder'
drive-grounding-gate.sh PASSES (exit 0) on the emitted prompt
cases.discriminating_power: high — baseline agent (and the pre-fix skill at line 238) said 'Open Claude Desktop, attach the Drive folder, paste the prompt'

cases.name: improve-attach-message-to-reference
cases.prompt:
Tidy up this hand-off so I can paste my research prompt:

Research prompt ready: R12-search.md
Open Claude Desktop, attach the Drive folder, then drag in the schema file, and paste the prompt.
cases.expected_behavior: Rewrites the hand-off to say the Drive workspace is connected and Claude reads the named doc(s) itself — removing 'attach the Drive folder' and 'drag in the schema file'.
assertions: Rewritten message states the Drive is connected / reads docs by name
The words 'attach' and 'drag' are removed from the instructions
drive-grounding-gate.sh PASSES (exit 0) on the rewritten message
cases.discriminating_power: high — baseline agent treats 'attach the Drive folder' as correct UI guidance and keeps it
